mentions.name: AI document editor
mentions.description: An AI-powered document editor that lets users edit documents directly with AI, eliminating the need to copy-paste text between ChatGPT and Google Docs or Notion and redo formatting afterward.
mentions.problem: Copy-pasting text between ChatGPT and Google Docs/Notion creates excessive formatting work and painful edits, and the plugins those platforms offer aren't as good.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a cursor for document editing. 
I'm tired of copy pasting text between ChatGPT and Google Docs/notion. There's too much formatting work after and the edits are a pain.
